requiresPassword.description: Whether unlocking after screenlock requires a password.

screenSleepTimeoutMs.description: Screenlock timeout in milliseconds, within signed 32-bit range. Preserve source sentinel values only if their provider meaning is known.

screenlockSettings.description: User's effective screenlock settings; required for each submitted user.

items.description: Human user and effective screenlock evidence.

externalUrl.description: HTTPS source-application link to this computer.

items.description: Windows security product state and collection evidence.

functions.name: update-control
functions.description: Partially modify a control's supported metadata without intentionally changing omitted fields.

name.description: Replacement name; empty text is submitted explicitly.

note.description: Replacement note; empty text clears it.

domain.description: Replacement security-domain category using Vanta's exact supported spelling.

externalId.description: Replacement external reference; empty text requests an empty reference.

description.description: Replacement control description; empty text clears it.

customFields.description: Complete replacement custom-field collection; [] requests clearing all values. Not a per-label merge.

implementationDetails.description: Replacement implementation narrative; empty text clears it.

changes.description: Partial metadata changes; omitted fields stay unchanged, null is not supported; empty text clears a text field where permitted.

FunctionInput_vanta_updatecontrol.description: A control identity and only the metadata changes to apply.

customFields.description: Current custom-field values returned after the update.

updatedAt.description: Modification instant in UTC, or null for library controls.

FunctionOutput_vanta_updatecontrol.description: Mutable control metadata returned by Vanta after the update.

tags.instructions: Get a control ID from `list-controls`; inspect `get-control` before changing existing metadata. Supply only fields to change. This can overwrite metadata and custom-field values. Use `create-custom-control` for a new identity and `disable-control` for lifecycle deactivation.

functions.name: update-person
functions.description: Partially update paired given/family names, employment start instant, or both.

name.description: New paired names; omission preserves the name.

first.description: New given name; empty is an explicit value.

employmentStartedAt.description: New start instant with explicit offset; omission preserves it.

employmentStartedAt.description: Returned employment start instant in UTC.

tags.instructions: Use personId from `list-people` or inspect it with `get-person`. Only names and employment start are supported, not email, groups, job title or offboarding. Supply both name components. Use `offboard-person` for eligible offboarding completion.

functions.name: update-vendor
functions.description: Partially modify a vendor's metadata, ownership, risk, contract, authentication, framework scope, and custom fields. Lifecycle status is changed separately.

category.description: Replacement category name; null is not supported.

authDetails.description: Partial authentication requirements; omitted subfields remain unchanged.

customFields.description: Changes to configured custom fields identified by label; omitted labels remain unchanged; text or [] requests the supplied value, not deletion of configuration.

label.description: Existing configured custom field label, unique in this request.

value.description: Replacement text or selected options for that field; empty values are preserved.

items.description: A configured custom field and its desired value.

contractAmount.description: Replacement contract value; null clears it.

scopeType.description: Apply to all, specified, or no frameworks.

frameworkIds.description: Applicable framework IDs, required for PARTIAL scope.

additionalNotes.description: Vendor notes; null clears them; empty text is distinct.

contractStartAt.description: Contract start instant with offset; null clears it.

riskAttributeIds.description: Replacement assigned risk attribute IDs; [] removes assignments.

contractRenewalAt.description: Contract renewal instant with offset; null clears it.

inherentRiskLevel.description: Manual risk level; null enables automatic scoring from risk attributes and rubric.

accountManagerName.description: External manager name; null clears it.

vendorHeadquarters.description: Supported Vanta region code such as USA or EUE; null clears it.

businessOwnerUserId.description: Business owner ID; null removes the owner.

securityOwnerUserId.description: Security owner ID; null removes the owner.

contractTerminationAt.description: Contract termination instant with offset; null clears it.

name.description: Vendor name returned after the update.

status.description: Vendor lifecycle status returned after metadata update; not changed by this tool.

Omitted fields are unchanged; supported nulls clear values, except inherentRiskLevel null enables Vanta auto-scoring. functions.name: upload-document-file

effectiveAt.description: Optional evidence effective instant with explicit offset; omitted when unspecified.

id.description: Uploaded-file ID, usable as uploadedFileId for download.
